notes: This is judging a work plan before it starts: is each step clear, checkable, complete in its inputs, and does the whole plan add up, ending in a go or no-go verdict. A quick reading may accept the tidy sequence without comparing names, dates, or required evidence. The roster, architecture, settings, operating notes, contract, and change rules need to be read alongside the plan. The human checker should expect a no-go until the blockers have actionable fixes.
